START.semantics: request equipment start after permissives; never closes breaker implicitly

STOP.semantics: normal stop; remove run enable; breaker remains in its existing state unless separate logic says otherwise

TRIP.semantics: protection trip request; success requires associated breaker CLOSED feedback = 0; analog process reduction alone is not Trip

RESET.semantics: clear latched trip only when reset permissives pass; no automatic restart or breaker close

BREAKER_CLOSE.semantics: explicit breaker close command; independent of START

DERATE.semantics: reduce process boundary/load while generator breaker remains CLOSED; never alias to TRIP

ST.secondary_physics_effect: close HP/MP turbine admission-valve commands and solve ThermoSysPro rundown

non_executable_reserved_equipment.CONDENSATE_PUMP: No standalone physical component in the pinned ThermoSysPro model; do not expose commands.
non_executable_reserved_equipment.CW_PUMP: No dedicated circulating-water pump component in the pinned ThermoSysPro model; do not expose commands.

time_contract.delay_evaluation: elapsed simulation time, not sample count

blind_policy: command records may contain actual user/logic commands but must not contain expected root-cause or answer labels
